entities.name: Saint Ahoadamah Church, Tikrit
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Church of Saint Ahudemmeh, also known as the Green Church, was a Syriac Orthodox church in Tikrit, Iraq. The church was destroyed by Islamic State militants on 25 September 2014.
